calendar.title: The abandoned cart flow, timed to the hour
calendar.hook: 7 in 10 carts never reach checkout.
calendar.beats:
1  Cover: 7 in 10 carts never reach checkout.
2  Someone who left a cart already chose the product and the price. A reminder finishes the conversation.
3  Email 1, within the first hour: catches interrupted shoppers.
4  SMS, 30 to 60 minutes after: only to shoppers who opted in. One message is enough.
5  Web push, around the one-hour mark.
6  Email 2, the next day: reaches people who decide overnight.
7  Email 3, day 3: if you use a discount, it goes here. It protects margin from shoppers who'd have come back anyway.
8  Stop at three emails. After that, complaints grow faster than revenue.
9  A well-timed flow typically recovers 2 to 5% of abandoned carts. See your number: free calculator, link in bio.

calendar.title: 6 subject line rules for BFCM

2  Keep it 30 to 50 characters.

7  Score it, then A/B test the top two on part of your list.
